$comment: Data-source settings used by scripts/fetch-sheets.mjs (runs inside GitHub Actions). Nothing here is secret. The service-account key must ONLY live in the GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON GitHub secret.
$comment_tabs: work & kpi are required/expected. target, sellerQc (seller-uploaded QC used by the Individual Summary report) and team (optional employee roster: Name, Full Name, Team, Status, Left Date) are optional.
$comment_excludeColumns: Columns that are NEVER written to the published data.json. GitHub Pages sites are public, so seller credentials must never be published. Add personal data columns (e.g. "Phone Number (KAM)", "Mail (KAM)", "Email Address") here if the site should not expose them.
$comment_dateColumns: Columns whose Google Sheets date serial numbers are converted to ISO dates. Any header containing 'date' or 'timestamp' is also treated as a date column automatically.
$comment_governance: Governance team tracker (separate spreadsheet). adhoc = regular REVAMP / Ad-Hoc task log. projects & progress tabs are created and written by the Apps Script in apps-script/Code.gs. appsScriptUrl = the Web app URL from that script's deployment (not a secret, but it allows writes). It is used for everyone and wins over the GitHub variable GOVERNANCE_APPS_SCRIPT_URL.
$comment_performance: Catalogue Overall Performance spreadsheet (Daily / Monthly performance report). Set the ID here or as the GitHub variable PERFORMANCE_SHEET_ID, and share the sheet with the service account (Viewer). Tab names match by prefix.
$comment_expectedWorkColumns: Used to locate the header row and to report missing columns. Missing columns are reported as warnings, never invented.
$comment_extraSources: Extra sheets read by the sync (share each with the service account as Viewer). gid = the number after #gid= in the sheet link. Login/password/phone/mail columns are never published.

retail.label: Retail [Picks] Upload Request
retail.$comment_columns: Fixed column letters, used instead of header names: skus = the uploaded SKU (picks) count, date = Upload Date (dates the picks in every report).
